_readme: SNAPSHOT, not truth. Compiled from secondary sources found while building this skill. Free tiers change monthly. Re-verify on the official page before relying on any number. Update snapshot_date only after re-verifying.

groq.notes: Per-model limits, counted per organization (not per key). Example model: gpt-oss-120b. Some signup flows require phone verification.
sources: dev.to 'Free LLM API Tiers in October 2026'

openrouter_free.notes: Free-model variants only. 50/day without purchased credits; reported 1,000/day after $10 lifetime credits. Capacity governed globally, extra accounts do not help. Free providers may log prompts. ToS reportedly prohibits reselling access or building a competing service.

gemini_api_free.notes: Vendor no longer publishes per-model free limits publicly; check AI Studio for your project's active numbers. Limits per project, not per key. Search grounding reportedly needs billing. Free-tier prompts may be used to improve products (not in EEA/UK/CH). Since the 2026-03-23 terms, reportedly only paid services may serve end users in EEA/CH/UK.

nvidia_nim.notes: A single source reports ~10,000 requests/day per model; signup may be gated by phone verification. Verify before depending on it.

cloudflare_workers_ai.notes: Reported 10,000 'Neurons'/day free allowance (unit is not requests). Check model pricing in neurons.

github_models.notes: Reported as closed to new users on 2026-07-30 by one source and removed from another list; treat as unavailable until verified.
